capabilities: Sync Kindle highlights and notes into vault
Match and convert books in Calibre
Generate deep links to book locations
Read EPUBs in a side-by-side pane
extras: Desktop-only plugin (isDesktopOnly: true). Close the Calibre desktop app during syncing or converting so SQLite does not lock metadata.db; if it is busy, Markdown updates and reading still complete with a non-fatal warning. A legacy standalone Python CLI (kindle_sync.py and related scripts) is retained for headless automation without Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull in Kindle highlights and notes or to read EPUB books next to them.

relations.evidence: syncing Kindle highlights and personal notes into your Obsidian vault

requires.name: Kindle device or Notebook HTML exports
GVFS/GIO, libmtp, or calibre-debug (for MTP Kindles)

summary: Desktop plugin that syncs Kindle highlights and personal notes into Obsidian and a Calibre library, with an embedded side-by-side EPUB reader.
